name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.31: the lighting panel now states whether a machine can drive its lights at all, standing, instead of only to whoever last pressed a test button. A set_led answer is the ONLY signal of that capability: the led config block is simply ignored by a build that does not implement it, silently, so a schedule can look saved and do nothing indefinitely. 8626020623 answered 'this build does not handle set_led' on test, which is the expected reply until the kiosk app lands ctlLed and ledBrightnessAdjustment - but that verdict was previously visible only in the test output. handleCommandResult now records every set_led verdict to meta as ledcap:<deviceCode>, mirroring the existing confighealth: pattern, and the machine detail endpoint exposes it as ledCapability. The panel renders it above every control: a quiet line when lighting has never been tested, a quiet green line with the date when it is confirmed working, and a loud warning carrying the machine's own words when it cannot - because every control below is then saving settings that do nothing, which is worth knowing before spending five minutes on a schedule rather than after. A live test updates the line in place, so the banner and the answer can never disagree on screen. Cumulative over v6.30.
